correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly uses the previously published complete facet and vertex descriptions for generalized parking-function polytopes: lower normals -e_i and upper normals 1_S with all nonempty S except |S|=n−1 when b1=1. At a simple vertex, nested upper facets, all lower/lower pairs, disjoint upper/lower pairs, and the classical b1=1 exceptional full-upper/lower incidences exhaust codimension-2 ridges. For S⊊T, outward normal cosine sqrt(|S|/|T|) gives interior angle π−acos sqrt(s/t), while orthogonal pairs give right angles and exceptional inner product −1/sqrt(n) yields acute acos(1/sqrt(n). Subset enumeration counts nested upper incidences by 3^n−2^{n+1}+1, removing n(2^{n−1}−1) in classical case; all right and n acute counts match. Independent direct subset-pair enumerations for n=3..6 verified both regimes (n=4: nonclassical U=50,R=34,A=0; classical U=22,R=30,A=4). The dominant nested pairs equal a ternary assignment up to O(n(2/3)^n) in total variation; multinomial delta method on s/(s+t) at (1/3,1/3) yields variance 3/8 and angle derivative 1 at ratio 1/2, proving 3π/4 Gaussian limit. verify_angles.py source independently forms actual facet/vertex incidence and checks 18 finite cases; its floating affine ranks are corroboration, not an all-n proof.
